verdict.rationale: Cua documents its own programmatic surfaces: an SDK to create and drive computers from Python, TypeScript and Rust, a CLI and MCP for the Driver, and the ability to follow agent work from the CLI or code. Nothing documents that every UI action (sharing Spaces, approving vault items, admin roles, the canvas) is reachable through the API, and no OpenAPI spec was found. Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity claim, a published API reference or OpenAPI spec, documented API coverage of sharing, permissions and admin features, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: Create and drive computers from your own code. Python, TypeScript and Rust.
lets an agent drive native apps on macOS, Windows and Linux in the background, through MCP or a CLI.
